title: Feature Sensitivity Scorecard: A Lightweight Metric Companion for SAELens

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Features that fire consistently on semantically equivalent inputs are more likely safety-relevant. A sensitivity metric helps filter SAE features for safety interventions. The impact chain is plausible but this is primarily a tooling contribution rather than a direct safety finding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing a single Python function that uses SAELens inference is straightforward. GPT-2-Small SAEs are small and fast. Hand-selecting features and creating paraphrase pairs is manual but not technically complex. Very beginner-accessible.
